item.description: New: Poora finishes your sentences as you type, in any app. The rest of the word, or the next few words, show in grey after the cursor: Tab takes them, and typing on passes them by. It runs on your Mac alone. Google's Gemma finishes whole phrases, a 3.35 GB download, once, at your click; without it, Poora finishes words only. It stays silent in password fields, search fields, terminals and code editors, and nothing you type leaves the Mac.
